title: 水袖惊梦
subtitle: 百年昆曲戏班传人选拔前夜，园林闭园，班主死在了戏箱房，脖子上缠着一条水袖。

victim.name: 顾鹤年
victim.bio: 七十二岁，苏州百年昆曲戏班「怡音社」第四代班主，唱了一辈子小生，脾气倔，眼里容不得一粒沙子。

background:
初秋，苏州古城里的私家园林「漪园」。怡音社在这座园子里驻场演出已近百年，戏台、水榭、戏箱房都是老祖宗留下的。明早十点，班主顾鹤年要在戏台上当众宣布怡音社的下一任传人，并举行「传箱仪式」——把装着百年老戏衣的樟木戏箱交到传人手里。

18:00 漪园闭园，园门落锁，园中只剩下戏班的人和管理处的方总。19:00 到 20:30 是最后一次彩排，班主全程黑着脸，一句话也没多说。

22:30，班主的孙女顾青推开戏箱房的门，发现顾鹤年倒在戏箱旁，颈上有勒痕，身旁散落着一条白绸水袖，人已经没了气息。

报警之后，警方要求所有人留在园中、不得走动，等待勘查。在警察赶到之前，你们五个人决定先把这一夜理清楚——因为凶手就在你们之中。
intro: 【主持人】欢迎来到《水袖惊梦》。这是一个进阶剧本：每个人都有秘密，每个人都说了谎，而说谎的人未必是凶手。请仔细阅读你的角色剧本，留意时间——笛声、监控、门禁，都可能骗人。

phaseNarration.investigate_1: 【主持人】第一轮搜证开始。每人可以搜查两次。园子里灯笼昏暗，找到的线索只有你自己知道，是否公开由你决定。
phaseNarration.discuss_1: 【主持人】第一轮讨论开始。你可以发言、质询某人、公开线索或指控嫌疑人。被质询的人必须立刻回答。
phaseNarration.investigate_2: 【主持人】夜更深了。第二轮搜证开始——有些细节，只有在看懂了前面的物证之后才会被注意到。
phaseNarration.discuss_2: 【主持人】最后一轮讨论。请把 21:00 到 22:00 之间每个人在哪里、谁能作证，一条一条对清楚。
phaseNarration.vote: 【主持人】投票环节。请投出你认为的凶手。得票最多者将被指认（平票则凶手逃脱）。

locations.name: 戏箱房
locations.description: 案发现场。存放百年樟木戏箱的老屋，前门对着戏台走廊，侧门通向一条临水的曲廊。

locations.name: 水榭
locations.description: 池塘边的水榭，柳婉卿平日在这里吹笛、调音。一条曲廊连着戏箱房的侧门。

locations.name: 鹤年斋
locations.description: 班主顾鹤年的书房，存放戏班的账册、文书和他的手稿。

locations.name: 化妆间
locations.description: 戏台后面的扮戏房，演员的衣架、化妆箱都在这里，门从不上锁。

locations.name: 管理处
locations.description: 园林管理处办公室，里面有监控主机和门禁电脑，窗口斜对着曲廊。

characters.name: 沈月棠
characters.publicBio: 28岁，怡音社当家闺门旦，顾鹤年手把手教出来的徒弟，明早传人选拔的热门人选。
characters.personality: 清冷、要强，说话轻声细语，一被逼问就会咬住嘴唇沉默。
characters.script:
你是沈月棠，怡音社的当家闺门旦，从十二岁起就跟着班主顾鹤年学戏。

上个月，你偷偷和一家影视公司签了经纪约，明年就要离开戏班去拍戏——可社规写明：传人十年内不得离社。前天，班主不知从哪弄到了合约复印件，在背面写了一句「月棠，你明知社规」，又还给了你。你知道，明天的传人多半与你无缘了。

【当晚经历】
19:00-20:30 戏台彩排。
20:35 你卸下水袖，搭在化妆间衣架上，回房间换衣服。
21:00 你戴着演出用的点翠发簪回到化妆间对镜练身段，没注意到水袖已经不在衣架上了。练功时一直能听见水榭那边的笛声。
21:40 你鼓起勇气去戏箱房求班主。推开门，看见班主倒在戏箱旁，脖子上缠着的竟是你的水袖。你吓得转身就跑，慌乱中发簪不知掉在了哪里。
21:45 你逃回化妆间，一直待到 22:30 听见顾青的尖叫。

【你的秘密】你签了外约；你 21:40 就看到了尸体，却因为害怕没有声张。
【你的说法】「21:00 以后我一直在化妆间练身段，没出过门。」

【你的任务】
1. 找出真凶——那条水袖分明是有人故意拿走的。
2. 不要让戏箱房门外的发簪被公开。

knowledge.text: 21:00 以后我一直在化妆间练身段，没出过门，22:30 才听见尖叫。
彩排完 20:35 我把水袖搭在化妆间衣架上就回房换衣服了，之后再没碰过它。
21:40 我去过戏箱房，推门时班主已经倒在地上，脖子上缠着我的水袖，我吓得跑了。
我上个月偷偷和影视公司签了约，明年要离开戏班，班主已经知道了。

characters.coverStory: 21:00 以后我一直在化妆间练身段，没出过门。

objectives.desc: 不让戏箱房门外的点翠发簪被公开

voice.style: 轻声细语，清冷克制，被逼问时就沉默

characters.name: 程小楼
characters.publicBio: 30岁，怡音社当家小生，从小在戏班长大，班主待他如亲孙，另一位传人候选。
characters.personality: 爽朗、好面子，说话声音很大，心虚时会故意岔开话题。
characters.script:
你是程小楼，怡音社的当家小生，六岁进戏班，是班主顾鹤年一口一口喂出来的。

半年前你查出声带小结，医生劝你停唱三个月，你却瞒着所有人，靠打针硬撑。今晚彩排你唱破了一个高音，班主的脸当场就沉了。

【当晚经历】
19:00-20:30 戏台彩排。
20:40 班主把你叫到鹤年斋：「你的嗓子瞒得过别人，瞒不过我。」你们大吵一架，你一气之下折断了自己的折扇，摔了茶盏。
20:55 你摔门离开时，听见班主拿起电话说：「九点一刻，戏箱房，把账本带来。」
21:08 你用演员卡从偏门溜出园子，去平江路一家熟识的诊所打了一针，想撑过明天的选拔。
21:52 你从偏门回来，直接回房。
22:30 听见尖叫。

【你的秘密】嗓子坏了；和班主大吵过；闭园后偷偷出过园。
【你的说法】「九点以后我一直在自己房里休息嗓子。」

【你的任务】
1. 找出真凶。
2. 不要让诊所收费单被公开——那等于告诉所有人，你再也唱不了了。

knowledge.text: 九点以后我一直在自己房里休息嗓子，哪儿也没去。
20:55 我路过鹤年斋，听见班主在电话里说：「九点一刻，戏箱房，把账本带来。」
20:40 我在鹤年斋和班主为嗓子的事大吵，折断了折扇、摔了茶盏。
21:08 到 21:52 我从偏门溜出园子，去平江路诊所打针了。

characters.coverStory: 九点以后我一直在自己房里休息嗓子。

objectives.desc: 不让诊所收费单被公开

voice.style: 嗓门大，爽朗好面子，心虚时会故意岔开话题

characters.name: 柳婉卿
characters.publicBio: 46岁，怡音社的笛师兼管事，跟了班主二十六年，戏班的账目、杂务都由她打理。
characters.personality: 温婉周到，总是替别人着想；说话慢条斯理，从不与人争执。
characters.script:
你是柳婉卿，怡音社的笛师兼管事，也是杀害顾鹤年的凶手。年轻时你也是台上的闺门旦，倒仓之后再没登过台，是班主留你下来吹笛、管账。

这五年，你陆续挪用了六十多万非遗补助款，替儿子填了窟窿。彩排结束后，你就知道班主查到了——20:55 他打来电话：「九点一刻，戏箱房，把账本带来。」

【当晚真实经历】
20:38 你趁化妆间没人，拿走了沈月棠搭在衣架上的水袖，塞进笛袋。
21:10 你在水榭吹了几分钟《皂罗袍》，让人听见；21:15 用藏在琴桌下的音箱播放事先录好的三十分钟练习录音，从曲廊走向戏箱房。
21:20 班主拿出账目，说明早传箱仪式上当众说清楚，然后报警。
21:30 你趁他转身，用水袖从背后勒住了他。挣扎中他抓住你别在腰间的笛子，笛膜被扯破。你把水袖丢在他身旁。
21:38 你从曲廊回到水榭。21:45 录音放完，笛声停了。

【你的谎言】「21:10 到 21:45 我一直在水榭吹笛，一步没离开。」

【你的任务】不被指认；不要让琴桌下的音箱被公开。把怀疑引向水袖的主人，或者关了监控的人。

knowledge.text: 21:10 到 21:45 我一直在水榭吹《皂罗袍》，一步也没离开，大家都听得见笛声。
21:15 我用音箱放录音冒充吹笛，21:20-21:38 在戏箱房用沈月棠的水袖勒死了班主。
这五年我挪用了六十多万非遗补助款。

characters.coverStory: 21:10 到 21:45 我一直在水榭吹笛，一步也没离开，大家都听得见。

objectives.desc: 不让琴桌下的音箱被公开

voice.style: 温婉柔和，慢条斯理，从不提高声音

characters.name: 方致远
characters.publicBio: 52岁，漪园文旅公司总经理，怡音社最大的赞助方。园里的钥匙、监控和门禁都归他管。
characters.personality: 八面玲珑，满口场面话；被问到细节时喜欢搬出规章制度。
characters.script:
你是方致远，漪园文旅公司的总经理，也是怡音社的金主。

一位海外收藏家出高价想买下怡音社那几只百年戏箱，你做居间人能拿一大笔佣金。班主一口回绝：「戏箱就是戏班的命。」你不死心，打算先拍照给收藏家估价，生米煮成熟饭再说。

【当晚经历】
20:35 你在管理处用管理员账户关掉了戏箱房走廊的摄像头。
20:40-21:00 你用万能钥匙进了戏箱房，把老戏衣一件件摊开拍照，慌乱中弄丢了镜头盖。那时班主还在鹤年斋。
21:00 回到管理处，和收藏家视频谈价，一直谈到 22:05。
21:25 你从窗口瞥见曲廊上有个人影快步往戏箱房方向走，手里拿着一根细长的东西，看不清是谁。奇怪的是，那会儿水榭的笛声还在响。
22:10 你想起监控没开，赶紧恢复。
22:30 听见尖叫。

【你的秘密】关监控、偷拍戏衣、私下撮合买卖。
【你的说法】「走廊监控是线路老化自己断的。九点以后我一直在管理处。」

【你的任务】
1. 找出真凶。
2. 不要让那份收购意向书被公开。

knowledge.text: 走廊那个摄像头是线路老化，自己断的，我也是后来才发现。
九点以后我一直在管理处办公室处理公事，22:30 听见尖叫才出来。
21:25 我从管理处窗口看见曲廊上有个人影快步往戏箱房走，手里拿着细长的东西，可那会儿水榭的笛声还在响。
20:35 我关了走廊监控，20:40-21:00 进戏箱房给老戏衣拍照，想卖给收藏家。

characters.coverStory: 走廊监控是线路老化自己断的。九点以后我一直在管理处办公室。

objectives.desc: 不让戏箱收购意向书被公开

voice.style: 圆滑客套，满口场面话，爱搬规章制度

characters.name: 顾青
characters.publicBio: 24岁，顾鹤年的孙女。从小学戏，十八岁那年不肯再唱，如今在做昆曲文创。今晚是她发现了爷爷。
characters.personality: 伶牙俐齿、敏感，嘴上不饶人，其实很怕被人看穿。
characters.script:
你是顾青，班主顾鹤年唯一的孙女。你十八岁那年和爷爷大吵一架，再也不肯唱戏，跑去做昆曲文创，结果工作室亏了三十多万。

上个月你走投无路，偷偷从戏箱里拿出一副祖传的点翠头面当了钱。听说爷爷明早要当众清点戏箱、举行传箱仪式，你今天下午东拼西凑把头面赎了回来，打算今晚趁没人塞回去。

【当晚经历】
19:00-20:30 在台下看彩排。
20:45 你把装着头面的帆布包放在化妆间角落。那时化妆间没人，沈月棠的衣架上已经没有水袖了。
21:10-21:45 你在听雨轩画图，窗子正对水榭，笛声一直没断。可你越听越怪：第三句总在同一个地方破音，一模一样，一遍又一遍。21:45 以后就再没声了。
22:30 你先去戏箱房看看有没有人，门虚掩、灯亮着，爷爷倒在戏箱旁。你尖叫起来。

【你的秘密】你当过、又赎回了点翠头面。
【你的说法】「22:30 我是去给爷爷送降压药的。」

【你的任务】
1. 找出真凶。
2. 不要成为得票最多的人。

knowledge.text: 21:10 到 21:45 水榭的笛声一直没断，可第三句总在同一个地方破音，一模一样，像在复读，21:45 以后就没声了。
20:45 我路过化妆间，里面没人，沈月棠的衣架上那时就已经没有水袖了。
22:30 我是去戏箱房给爷爷送降压药的，一推门就看见他倒在地上。
上个月我偷偷当了戏箱里的点翠头面，今天下午才赎回来，想今晚放回去。

characters.coverStory: 22:30 我是去给爷爷送降压药的，一推门就看见他倒在地上。

objectives.desc: 不要成为得票最多的人

voice.style: 伶牙俐齿，语速快，嘴上不饶人

victimRelationships.label: 班主与管事·共事二十六年
赞助方·为戏箱起过争执

clues.title: 尸体初检
clues.text: 顾鹤年颈部有一道宽而浅的勒痕，纹路细密，像是被丝织物从背后勒住。双手指甲缝里有几丝竹屑样的碎末。从体温和尸僵判断，死亡时间约在 21:20 到 21:50 之间。

clues.title: 白绸水袖
clues.text: 尸体旁散落着一条约两米长的白绸水袖，绸面有被大力扯拽的皱痕。袖口内侧用丝线绣着「月棠」二字。

clues.title: 水袖褶皱里的薄膜
clues.text: 把水袖完全展开细看，褶皱深处粘着一小片薄如蝉翼的半透明白膜，指甲盖大小，边缘有干掉的胶痕。它不是布料，也不是纸。

clues.title: 被翻动的戏箱
clues.text: 戏箱旁的地上有一个黑色相机镜头盖。好几只樟木戏箱的铜锁扣被打开过，老戏衣被一件件摊平摆好，像是有人逐件拍过照。

clues.title: 班主的清点单
clues.text: 一张班主亲笔的戏箱清点单：蟒、帔、褶子逐项打了勾，唯独「点翠头面一副」后面写着：「缺。问青儿。」

clues.title: 门外石阶上的发簪
clues.text: 戏箱房前门外的石阶缝里卡着一支点翠蝴蝶发簪，是闺门旦扮相用的头饰，簪脚刻着一个小小的「沈」字。簪子很干净，掉在这里应该没多久。

clues.title: 笛膜破了的曲笛
clues.text: 琴桌上横放着柳婉卿常用的那支紫竹曲笛。笛膜裂了一道口子，还缺了指甲盖大的一小块，笛身上有几道新鲜的刮痕。行内人都知道：笛膜一破，就只能吹出沙哑漏气的声音。

clues.title: 琴桌下的音箱
clues.text: 既然笛子吹不响，你俯身细看琴桌，在桌下的暗格里摸到一个巴掌大的蓝牙音箱，电量几乎耗尽。最后播放的是一段名为「皂罗袍·练习」的录音，时长整整三十分钟。

clues.title: 曲廊青苔上的滑痕
clues.text: 从水榭到戏箱房侧门有一条临水曲廊，快步走不到三分钟。廊边的青苔上有两道新鲜的滑痕，一道朝向戏箱房，一道朝回水榭。

clues.title: 传人决定的草稿
clues.text: 书桌上一张传人决定的草稿，「沈月棠」和「程小楼」两个名字都被划掉了，旁边一行小字：「一个瞒嗓子，一个瞒合约。明早再定。」

clues.title: 折断的折扇
clues.text: 地上有一把从中间折断的泥金折扇，扇面题着「小楼雅正」，旁边是摔碎的茶盏，茶渍还没干透。

clues.title: 台历上的约定
clues.text: 台历上今天的格子里用毛笔写着：「21:15 戏箱房 对账」。

clues.title: 补助账本
clues.text: 知道班主约了人对账，你翻开抽屉里的非遗补助账本：近五年有六十多万对不上，页边全是班主的红笔批注，最后一页写着「今晚问清」。

clues.title: 空了的衣架
clues.text: 沈月棠的衣架上挂着褶子和裙子，唯独水袖不见了。化妆间的门从不上锁，彩排之后谁都可能进出。

clues.title: 化妆箱里的合约
clues.text: 沈月棠的化妆箱夹层里有一份影视公司经纪合约的复印件，上月签署，写明「乙方须于明年起脱离原剧团」。背面是班主的红笔字：「月棠，你明知社规。」

clues.title: 诊所收费单
clues.text: 程小楼外套口袋里有一张平江路一家诊所的收费单，开具时间 21:31，项目「咽喉局部注射」，医嘱：「声带小结，建议停唱三个月。」

clues.title: 帆布包里的锦盒
clues.text: 化妆间角落有一只别着顾青工作牌的帆布包，里面是一个锦盒，装着一副点翠头面，还有一张典当行的赎当凭证：「点翠头面一副，今日 17:20 赎回。」

clues.title: 监控日志
clues.text: 监控主机日志：戏箱房走廊摄像头 20:35 被「管理员账户」手动关闭，22:10 手动恢复。这段时间走廊没有任何画面。曲廊一带本来就没有摄像头。

clues.title: 门禁记录
clues.text: 门禁电脑显示：18:00 闭园后正门没有任何进出。只有偏门有一条记录——「演员卡 03（登记人：程小楼）」21:08 刷卡出、21:52 刷卡进。

clues.title: 戏箱收购意向书
clues.text: 办公桌抽屉里一份《百年戏箱整体收购意向书》，买方是一位海外收藏家，居间人一栏签着方致远的名字，附件写着「戏衣照片待补」。

truth.summary: 凶手是笛师兼管事柳婉卿。她五年来挪用了六十多万非遗补助款，班主顾鹤年查到后约她 21:15 到戏箱房对账，准备明早当众揭穿并报警。柳婉卿事先在化妆间偷走沈月棠的水袖，又用藏在水榭琴桌下的音箱播放三十分钟的练笛录音，制造「一直在吹笛」的不在场证明。21:30 她在戏箱房用水袖从背后勒死班主，挣扎中别在腰间的曲笛被班主抓住，笛膜扯破，一小片笛膜粘进了水袖褶皱；她把水袖留在现场嫁祸沈月棠。破绽在于：笛膜破了的笛子吹不出清亮的笛声，而笛声却「一模一样地破音」响到 21:45；水袖上的笛膜碎片与曲笛缺口吻合；水袖在沈月棠回化妆间之前就已经不见了。

timeline.text: 沈月棠把水袖搭在化妆间衣架上回房换衣；方致远用管理员账户关闭走廊监控。
柳婉卿趁化妆间无人，偷走沈月棠的水袖。
程小楼在鹤年斋与班主为嗓子大吵；方致远在戏箱房偷拍戏衣（至 21:00）。
班主打电话约柳婉卿：「九点一刻，戏箱房，把账本带来。」
程小楼从偏门溜出园子去诊所打针。
柳婉卿在水榭吹笛，随后改用音箱播放三十分钟录音，经曲廊前往戏箱房。
班主当面质问账目；21:30 柳婉卿用水袖勒死班主，笛膜在挣扎中破裂。
方致远在管理处窗口看见曲廊上有人影走向戏箱房，同时听见笛声。
柳婉卿经曲廊返回水榭。
沈月棠去戏箱房求情，发现尸体和自己的水袖，惊慌逃走，掉落发簪。
录音播放完毕，笛声停止。
顾青想去戏箱房放回点翠头面，发现尸体。

secrets.text: 私签影视经纪约；21:40 已发现尸体却没有声张。
声带小结、靠打针硬撑；和班主大吵；闭园后偷偷出园就医。
凶手；五年挪用六十多万非遗补助款。
关掉监控、偷拍戏衣，私下撮合把百年戏箱卖给海外收藏家。
偷当了祖传点翠头面，今晚想偷偷放回戏箱。

contradictions.text: 柳婉卿说自己一直在水榭吹笛，可她的曲笛笛膜破了一块，根本吹不出清亮的笛声。
沈月棠说自己没出过化妆间，可她的发簪掉在了戏箱房门外。
方致远说监控是线路老化自己断的，日志却显示是管理员账户手动关闭的。
程小楼说九点后一直在房里休息，门禁却显示他 21:08 到 21:52 出了园子——他撒了谎，但这恰好覆盖了死亡时间。
顾青说去戏箱房是送药，可她的包里装着今天刚赎回来的点翠头面。

author: MysteryAgents

en.title: Water Sleeves, Broken Dream
en.subtitle: On the eve of choosing the heir to a century-old kunqu troupe, the garden is locked for the night, and the troupe master lies dead in the costume-trunk room, a water sleeve wound around his neck.
en.background:
Early autumn, Yi Garden, a classical private garden in the old city of Suzhou. The Yiyin Troupe has performed in residence here for nearly a hundred years; the stage, the waterside pavilion and the costume-trunk room were all left to them by the founders. At 10:00 tomorrow morning, troupe master Gu Henian is to announce the troupe's next heir on stage in front of everyone and hold the “passing of the trunk” ceremony, handing over the camphor-wood trunk that holds the century-old costumes.

At 18:00 Yi Garden closes and the gates are locked, leaving only the troupe and Mr. Fang of the management office inside. From 19:00 to 20:30 is the final rehearsal; the master scowls through all of it and barely says a word.

At 22:30, the master's granddaughter Gu Qing pushes open the door of the costume-trunk room and finds Gu Henian collapsed beside a trunk, ligature marks on his neck, a white silk water sleeve lying loose beside him. He is no longer breathing.

The police have been called and have ordered everyone to stay in the garden and not wander off until they arrive. Before they do, the five of you decide to piece this night together yourselves, because the killer is one of you.
en.intro: [Host] Welcome to Water Sleeves, Broken Dream. This is an intermediate scenario: everyone has a secret, everyone has told a lie, and the one who lies is not necessarily the killer. Read your character script carefully and watch the times: flute music, cameras and gate logs can all deceive.

victim.name: Gu Henian
victim.bio: 72, fourth-generation master of the Yiyin Troupe, a century-old kunqu (classical Chinese opera) company in Suzhou. He sang young-scholar roles all his life; stubborn, and unable to let even a grain of sand slip past his eyes.

phaseNarration.investigate_1: [Host] The first round of investigation begins. Each of you may search twice. The lanterns in the garden are dim; the clues you find are known only to you, and whether to reveal them is your choice.
phaseNarration.discuss_1: [Host] The first round of discussion begins. You may speak, question someone, reveal a clue or accuse a suspect. Whoever is questioned must answer at once.
phaseNarration.investigate_2: [Host] The night grows deeper. The second round of investigation begins. Some details only get noticed once you understand the evidence that came before.
phaseNarration.discuss_2: [Host] The final round of discussion. Go through it one person at a time: where was each of you between 21:00 and 22:00, and who can vouch for it?
phaseNarration.vote: [Host] Time to vote. Cast your vote for the person you believe is the killer. Whoever receives the most votes will be named (in a tie, the killer escapes).

xiangfang.name: Costume-Trunk Room
xiangfang.description: The crime scene. An old room that stores the century-old camphor-wood costume trunks. Its front door faces the stage corridor; a side door opens onto a winding waterside gallery.

shuixie.name: Waterside Pavilion
shuixie.description: A pavilion at the edge of the pond, where Liu Wanqing usually plays and tunes her flute. A winding gallery connects it to the side door of the costume-trunk room.

henian.name: Henian Studio
henian.description: Troupe master Gu Henian's study, where he keeps the troupe's account books, papers and his manuscripts.

huazhuang.name: Dressing Room
huazhuang.description: The make-up room behind the stage, holding the actors' costume racks and make-up cases. The door is never locked.

guanli.name: Management Office
guanli.description: The garden management office, with the CCTV server and the gate-access computer. Its window looks out at an angle onto the winding gallery.

shen_yuetang.name: Shen Yuetang
shen_yuetang.publicBio: 28, the Yiyin Troupe's leading guimendan (young-lady role), a disciple Gu Henian trained by hand, and a favorite to be named heir tomorrow morning.
shen_yuetang.personality: Cool and proud, soft-spoken; when pressed, she bites her lip and falls silent.
shen_yuetang.script:
You are Shen Yuetang, the Yiyin Troupe's leading guimendan (young-lady role). You have studied under troupe master Gu Henian since you were twelve.

Last month you secretly signed a management contract with a film and TV company; next year you will leave the troupe to act on screen. But the troupe rules state plainly that the heir may not leave the troupe for ten years. The day before yesterday, the master somehow got hold of a copy of the contract, wrote on the back “Yuetang, you know the rules,” and handed it back to you. You know tomorrow's title of heir is probably not going to be yours.

[Tonight]
19:00-20:30 Rehearsal on stage.
20:35 You take off your water sleeves, drape them over the costume rack in the dressing room, and go back to your room to change.
21:00 You return to the dressing room wearing the kingfisher-feather hairpin from your stage costume and practice your movements in front of the mirror. You do not notice that the water sleeve is no longer on the rack. The whole time you practice, you can hear the flute from the waterside pavilion.
21:40 You work up the courage to go to the costume-trunk room and plead with the master. You push open the door and see him collapsed beside a trunk, and wrapped around his neck is your own water sleeve. Terrified, you turn and run, and in the panic your hairpin falls somewhere.
21:45 You flee back to the dressing room and stay there until 22:30, when you hear Gu Qing scream.

[Your secrets] You signed an outside contract; you saw the body at 21:40 but were too frightened to say anything.
[Your story] “After 21:00 I was in the dressing room practicing my movements the whole time. I never left.”

[Your objectives]
1. Find the real killer. Someone clearly took that water sleeve on purpose.
2. Do not let the hairpin outside the costume-trunk room door be made public.
shen_yuetang.coverStory: After 21:00 I was in the dressing room practicing my movements the whole time. I never left.

knowledge.k_shen_cover: After 21:00 I was in the dressing room practicing my movements the whole time and never left. I only heard the scream at 22:30.
knowledge.k_shen_sleeve: After rehearsal, at 20:35, I draped my water sleeve over the rack in the dressing room and went back to my room to change. I never touched it again.
knowledge.k_shen_saw: At 21:40 I went to the costume-trunk room. When I pushed the door open the master was already on the floor with my water sleeve around his neck. I panicked and ran.
knowledge.k_shen_contract: Last month I secretly signed with a film and TV company. Next year I'm leaving the troupe, and the master already knew.

objectives: Keep the kingfisher-feather hairpin outside the costume-trunk room from being made public

voice.style: Soft-spoken, cool and restrained; goes silent when pressed

cheng_xiaolou.name: Cheng Xiaolou
cheng_xiaolou.publicBio: 30, the Yiyin Troupe's leading xiaosheng (young-scholar role). He grew up in the troupe, the master treats him like his own grandson, and he is the other candidate for heir.
cheng_xiaolou.personality: Hearty and image-conscious, with a loud voice; when he has something to hide, he deliberately changes the subject.
cheng_xiaolou.script:
You are Cheng Xiaolou, the Yiyin Troupe's leading xiaosheng (young-scholar role). You joined the troupe at six, and troupe master Gu Henian raised you practically spoonful by spoonful.

Six months ago you were diagnosed with vocal-cord nodules. The doctor told you to stop singing for three months, but you hid it from everyone and have been pushing through on injections. At tonight's rehearsal your voice cracked on a high note, and the master's face darkened on the spot.

[Tonight]
19:00-20:30 Rehearsal on stage.
20:40 The master calls you to Henian Studio: “You can hide your voice from the others, but not from me.” The two of you have a huge row; in a fit of anger you snap your own folding fan and smash a teacup.
20:55 As you storm out, you hear the master pick up the phone and say: “Quarter past nine, the costume-trunk room. Bring the account book.”
21:08 You use your actor's card to slip out of the garden through the side gate and go to a clinic you know on Pingjiang Road for an injection, hoping to get through tomorrow's selection.
21:52 You come back through the side gate and go straight to your room.
22:30 You hear the scream.

[Your secrets] Your voice is damaged; you had a huge row with the master; you secretly left the garden after closing.
[Your story] “After nine I was in my own room the whole time, resting my voice.”

[Your objectives]
1. Find the real killer.
2. Do not let the clinic receipt be made public. That would tell everyone you can never sing again.
cheng_xiaolou.coverStory: After nine I was in my own room the whole time, resting my voice.

knowledge.k_cheng_cover: After nine I was in my own room the whole time resting my voice. I didn't go anywhere.
knowledge.k_cheng_phone: At 20:55, passing Henian Studio, I heard the master say on the phone: “Quarter past nine, the costume-trunk room. Bring the account book.”
knowledge.k_cheng_argue: At 20:40 the master and I had a huge row in Henian Studio about my voice. I snapped my folding fan and smashed a teacup.
knowledge.k_cheng_out: From 21:08 to 21:52 I slipped out of the garden through the side gate and went to a clinic on Pingjiang Road for an injection.

objectives: Keep the clinic receipt from being made public

voice.style: Loud and hearty, proud; changes the subject when uneasy

liu_wanqing.name: Liu Wanqing
liu_wanqing.publicBio: 46, the Yiyin Troupe's flautist and manager. She has been with the master for twenty-six years and handles the troupe's accounts and odd jobs.
liu_wanqing.personality: Gentle and considerate, always thinking of others; speaks slowly and deliberately and never argues with anyone.
liu_wanqing.script:
You are Liu Wanqing, the Yiyin Troupe's flautist and manager, and you are the one who killed Gu Henian. When you were young you too sang guimendan (young-lady roles) on stage, but after your voice broke you never performed again; it was the master who kept you on to play the flute and keep the books.

Over the past five years you have gradually embezzled more than 600,000 yuan of intangible-heritage subsidy money to cover your son's debts. When rehearsal ended you knew the master had found out. At 20:55 he phoned you: “Quarter past nine, the costume-trunk room. Bring the account book.”

[What really happened tonight]
20:38 While the dressing room is empty, you take the water sleeve Shen Yuetang left on the rack and stuff it into your flute bag.
21:10 You play a few minutes of “Zaoluopao” in the waterside pavilion so that people hear you. At 21:15 you use a speaker hidden under the zither table to play a thirty-minute practice recording you made beforehand, and walk along the winding gallery to the costume-trunk room.
21:20 The master brings out the accounts and says he will lay it all out publicly at the passing-of-the-trunk ceremony tomorrow morning and then call the police.
21:30 When he turns his back, you strangle him from behind with the water sleeve. In the struggle he grabs the flute tucked at your waist and tears the flute membrane. You drop the water sleeve beside him.
21:38 You return to the waterside pavilion along the winding gallery. At 21:45 the recording ends and the flute music stops.

[Your lie] “From 21:10 to 21:45 I was in the waterside pavilion playing the flute the whole time. I never took a step away.”

[Your objectives] Avoid being named; do not let the speaker under the zither table be made public. Steer suspicion toward the owner of the water sleeve, or toward whoever switched off the cameras.
liu_wanqing.coverStory: From 21:10 to 21:45 I was in the waterside pavilion playing the flute the whole time. I never took a step away; everyone could hear it.

knowledge.k_liu_cover: From 21:10 to 21:45 I was in the waterside pavilion playing “Zaoluopao” the whole time. I never took a step away, and everyone could hear the flute.
knowledge.k_liu_truth: At 21:15 I used a speaker to play a recording in place of my flute. From 21:20 to 21:38, in the costume-trunk room, I strangled the master with Shen Yuetang's water sleeve.
knowledge.k_liu_money: Over these five years I embezzled more than 600,000 yuan of intangible-heritage subsidy money.

objectives: Avoid being voted out as the killer
Keep the speaker under the zither table from being made public

voice.style: Gentle and warm, unhurried, never raises her voice

fang_zhiyuan.name: Fang Zhiyuan
fang_zhiyuan.publicBio: 52, general manager of the Yi Garden cultural tourism company and the Yiyin Troupe's biggest sponsor. The garden's keys, cameras and gate access are all under his control.
fang_zhiyuan.personality: Smooth and well-connected, full of polite platitudes; when asked for details, he likes to cite rules and regulations.
fang_zhiyuan.script:
You are Fang Zhiyuan, general manager of the Yi Garden cultural tourism company and the Yiyin Troupe's financial backer.

An overseas collector has offered a high price for the troupe's century-old costume trunks, and as the middleman you stand to earn a huge commission. The master flatly refused: “The trunks are the troupe's lifeblood.” You haven't given up. Your plan is to photograph everything for the collector's valuation first and deal with the fallout once it's a done deal.

[Tonight]
20:35 In the management office, you use the administrator account to switch off the camera in the costume-trunk room corridor.
20:40-21:00 You use the master key to enter the costume-trunk room and lay out the old costumes one by one to photograph them. In your haste you lose your lens cap. At that time the master is still in Henian Studio.
21:00 You return to the management office and negotiate prices with the collector over video call until 22:05.
21:25 Through the window you glimpse a figure hurrying along the winding gallery toward the costume-trunk room, holding something long and thin. You can't make out who it is. The strange thing is, the flute in the waterside pavilion is still playing at that moment.
22:10 You remember the camera is still off and quickly switch it back on.
22:30 You hear the scream.

[Your secrets] You switched off the camera, secretly photographed the costumes, and are privately brokering a sale.
[Your story] “The corridor camera cut out on its own because of old wiring. After nine I was in the management office the whole time.”

[Your objectives]
1. Find the real killer.
2. Do not let the letter of intent to purchase be made public.
fang_zhiyuan.coverStory: The corridor camera cut out on its own because of old wiring. After nine I was in the management office the whole time.

knowledge.k_fang_cover: That corridor camera cut out on its own because of old wiring. I only found out later myself.
knowledge.k_fang_office: After nine I was in the management office the whole time dealing with business. I only came out when I heard the scream at 22:30.
knowledge.k_fang_figure: At 21:25, from the management office window, I saw a figure hurrying along the winding gallery toward the costume-trunk room, holding something long and thin. But at that moment the flute in the waterside pavilion was still playing.
knowledge.k_fang_photo: At 20:35 I switched off the corridor camera, and from 20:40 to 21:00 I went into the costume-trunk room to photograph the old costumes. I wanted to sell them to a collector.

objectives: Keep the letter of intent to buy the costume trunks from being made public

voice.style: Smooth and courteous, full of stock phrases, quick to cite the rules

gu_qing.name: Gu Qing
gu_qing.publicBio: 24, Gu Henian's granddaughter. She studied opera from childhood but refused to sing anymore at eighteen, and now runs a kunqu-themed creative merchandise business. Tonight, she was the one who found her grandfather.
gu_qing.personality: Sharp-tongued and sensitive, never lets anything slide in an argument, but is secretly terrified of being seen through.
gu_qing.script:
You are Gu Qing, troupe master Gu Henian's only granddaughter. At eighteen you had a huge fight with your grandfather, refused ever to sing again, and went off to start a kunqu-themed creative merchandise business. Your studio ended up losing more than 300,000 yuan.

Last month, out of options, you secretly took an heirloom set of kingfisher-feather headdress ornaments from the costume trunk and pawned it. When you heard your grandfather would publicly inventory the trunks and hold the passing-of-the-trunk ceremony tomorrow morning, you scraped together the money this afternoon and redeemed the headdress, planning to slip it back in tonight while no one was around.

[Tonight]
19:00-20:30 You watch the rehearsal from the audience.
20:45 You leave the canvas bag holding the headdress in a corner of the dressing room. No one is in the dressing room at that time, and the water sleeve is already gone from Shen Yuetang's rack.
21:10-21:45 You are sketching designs in the Rain-Listening Pavilion, whose window faces the waterside pavilion. The flute never stops. But the longer you listen, the stranger it sounds: the third line always cracks in exactly the same spot, identical every time, over and over. After 21:45 there is no more sound.
22:30 You go to the costume-trunk room first to check whether anyone is there. The door is ajar, the light is on, and your grandfather is lying beside a trunk. You scream.

[Your secret] You pawned, then redeemed, the kingfisher-feather headdress.
[Your story] “At 22:30 I was bringing Grandpa his blood-pressure medicine.”

[Your objectives]
1. Find the real killer.
2. Do not be the person with the most votes.
gu_qing.coverStory: At 22:30 I was bringing Grandpa his blood-pressure medicine. The moment I pushed the door open I saw him on the floor.

knowledge.k_gu_flute: From 21:10 to 21:45 the flute in the waterside pavilion never stopped, but the third line always cracked in exactly the same spot, identical every time, like it was on repeat. After 21:45 there was no more sound.
knowledge.k_gu_rack: At 20:45 I passed the dressing room. No one was inside, and the water sleeve was already gone from Shen Yuetang's rack.
knowledge.k_gu_cover: At 22:30 I went to the costume-trunk room to bring Grandpa his blood-pressure medicine. The moment I pushed the door open I saw him on the floor.
knowledge.k_gu_pawn: Last month I secretly pawned the kingfisher-feather headdress from the costume trunk. I only redeemed it this afternoon and meant to put it back tonight.

objectives: Do not be the person with the most votes

voice.style: Sharp-tongued and quick, never lets anything slide

relationships: Flautist and lead actress, old partners
Sponsor and manager, go over accounts
victimRelationships: Master and disciple for sixteen years
Mentor, like a grandfather to him
Sponsor, clashed over the costume trunks

c_body.title: Preliminary Examination of the Body
c_body.text: Gu Henian's neck bears a wide, shallow ligature mark with a fine, dense texture, as if he were strangled from behind with a silk fabric. Under the fingernails of both hands are a few fragments like bamboo shavings. Judging by body temperature and rigor mortis, the time of death was roughly between 21:20 and 21:50.

c_sleeve.title: White Silk Water Sleeve
c_sleeve.text: Lying loose beside the body is a white silk water sleeve about two meters long, its surface creased as if it had been yanked with great force. Inside the cuff, the characters for “Yuetang” are embroidered in silk thread.

c_flake.title: Thin Film in the Sleeve's Folds
c_flake.text: Unfolding the water sleeve completely and examining it closely, you find a tiny piece of translucent white film, thin as a cicada's wing, stuck deep in a fold. It is the size of a fingernail, with traces of dried glue along the edge. It is not fabric, and it is not paper.

c_lenscap.title: The Disturbed Costume Trunks
c_lenscap.text: On the floor beside the trunks lies a black camera lens cap. The brass clasps on several camphor-wood trunks have been opened, and the old costumes have been laid out flat one by one, as if someone photographed them piece by piece.

c_inventory.title: The Master's Inventory List
c_inventory.text: A costume-trunk inventory in the master's own hand: the python robes, formal cloaks and pleated robes are each ticked off, except for “one set of kingfisher-feather headdress ornaments,” after which is written: “Missing. Ask Qing'er.”

c_hairpin.title: Hairpin on the Steps Outside
c_hairpin.text: Wedged in a crack in the stone steps outside the front door of the costume-trunk room is a kingfisher-feather butterfly hairpin, a headdress piece for the guimendan (young-lady) costume. Engraved on its stem is a tiny character: “Shen.” The hairpin is clean; it can't have been lying here long.

c_flute.title: Flute with a Torn Membrane
c_flute.text: Lying across the zither table is the purple-bamboo qudi flute Liu Wanqing always uses. The flute membrane has a split in it, with a fingernail-sized piece missing, and there are several fresh scratches on the body. Anyone in the trade knows: once the membrane tears, the flute can only produce a hoarse, leaky sound.

c_speaker.title: Speaker Under the Zither Table
c_speaker.text: Since the flute can't play properly, you bend down to examine the zither table and, in a hidden compartment underneath, find a palm-sized Bluetooth speaker with its battery nearly dead. The last thing it played was a recording titled “Zaoluopao - practice,” exactly thirty minutes long.

c_moss.title: Skid Marks in the Gallery Moss
c_moss.text: A winding waterside gallery runs from the waterside pavilion to the side door of the costume-trunk room; at a quick walk it takes under three minutes. In the moss along the edge of the gallery are two fresh skid marks, one heading toward the costume-trunk room and one heading back toward the waterside pavilion.

c_draft.title: Draft of the Heir Decision
c_draft.text: On the desk is a draft of the heir decision. The names “Shen Yuetang” and “Cheng Xiaolou” have both been crossed out, with a line of small writing beside them: “One hides his voice, one hides her contract. Decide tomorrow morning.”

c_fan.title: The Snapped Folding Fan
c_fan.text: On the floor is a gold-flecked folding fan snapped down the middle, its leaf inscribed “For Xiaolou, with fond regards.” Beside it is a smashed teacup; the tea stain is not yet dry.

c_schedule.title: Appointment on the Desk Calendar
c_schedule.text: In today's square on the desk calendar, written in brush and ink: “21:15 costume-trunk room, audit accounts.”

c_ledger.title: Subsidy Account Book
c_ledger.text: Knowing the master had arranged to audit the accounts with someone, you open the intangible-heritage subsidy account book in the drawer: over the past five years more than 600,000 yuan doesn't add up. The margins are full of the master's red-ink notes, and the last page reads: “Get answers tonight.”

c_rack.title: The Empty Costume Rack
c_rack.text: Shen Yuetang's rack holds her pleated robe and skirt, but the water sleeve is missing. The dressing room door is never locked; after rehearsal, anyone could have come and gone.

c_contract.title: Contract in the Make-up Case
c_contract.text: In the hidden compartment of Shen Yuetang's make-up case is a copy of a management contract with a film and TV company, signed last month, stating “Party B must leave her original troupe starting next year.” On the back, in the master's red ink: “Yuetang, you know the rules.”

c_receipt.title: Clinic Receipt
c_receipt.text: In Cheng Xiaolou's jacket pocket is a receipt from a clinic on Pingjiang Road, issued at 21:31, for a “local throat injection,” with the doctor's note: “Vocal-cord nodules; recommend no singing for three months.”

c_pawn.title: Brocade Box in the Canvas Bag
c_pawn.text: In a corner of the dressing room is a canvas bag with Gu Qing's work badge clipped to it. Inside is a brocade box holding a set of kingfisher-feather headdress ornaments, along with a pawnshop redemption slip: “One set of kingfisher-feather headdress ornaments, redeemed today at 17:20.”

c_cctvlog.title: CCTV Log
c_cctvlog.text: CCTV server log: the costume-trunk room corridor camera was manually switched off by the “administrator account” at 20:35 and manually restored at 22:10. There is no footage of the corridor during that period. The winding gallery area has no cameras at all.

c_gate.title: Gate Access Records
c_gate.text: The gate-access computer shows no entries or exits through the main gate after closing at 18:00. The side gate has only one record: “Actor Card 03 (registered to: Cheng Xiaolou)” swiped out at 21:08 and back in at 21:52.

c_deal.title: Letter of Intent to Buy the Trunks
c_deal.text: In the desk drawer is a “Letter of Intent for the Purchase of the Century-Old Costume Trunks as a Whole.” The buyer is an overseas collector, the middleman field is signed by Fang Zhiyuan, and the attachment notes “costume photos to follow.”

contradictions.x_flute: Liu Wanqing says she was playing the flute in the waterside pavilion the whole time, but a piece of her flute's membrane is torn away. It could never have produced clear flute music.
contradictions.x_hairpin: Shen Yuetang says she never left the dressing room, yet her hairpin was found outside the costume-trunk room door.
contradictions.x_cctv: Fang Zhiyuan says the camera cut out on its own due to old wiring, but the log shows it was switched off manually by the administrator account.
contradictions.x_gate: Cheng Xiaolou says he was resting in his room after nine, but the gate log shows he was out of the garden from 21:08 to 21:52. He lied, but that window happens to cover the time of death.
contradictions.x_pawn: Gu Qing says she went to the costume-trunk room to bring medicine, yet her bag holds the kingfisher-feather headdress she redeemed only today.

truth.weapon: Shen Yuetang's white silk water sleeve
truth.summary: The killer is Liu Wanqing, the flautist and manager. Over five years she embezzled more than 600,000 yuan of intangible-heritage subsidy money. When troupe master Gu Henian found out, he told her to meet him in the costume-trunk room at 21:15 to go over the accounts, intending to expose her publicly the next morning and call the police. Liu Wanqing had earlier stolen Shen Yuetang's water sleeve from the dressing room, and used a speaker hidden under the zither table in the waterside pavilion to play a thirty-minute flute-practice recording, creating the alibi that she was “playing the flute the whole time.” At 21:30, in the costume-trunk room, she strangled the master from behind with the water sleeve. In the struggle he grabbed the qudi flute tucked at her waist and tore its membrane, and a small piece of the membrane stuck in the folds of the sleeve. She left the sleeve at the scene to frame Shen Yuetang. The flaws: a flute with a torn membrane cannot play clear notes, yet the flute music, “cracking in exactly the same way,” went on until 21:45; the membrane fragment on the water sleeve matches the gap in the flute; and the water sleeve was already gone before Shen Yuetang returned to the dressing room.
timeline: Shen Yuetang drapes her water sleeve over the dressing room rack and goes to change; Fang Zhiyuan switches off the corridor camera with the administrator account.
With the dressing room empty, Liu Wanqing steals Shen Yuetang's water sleeve.
Cheng Xiaolou has a huge row with the master in Henian Studio about his voice; Fang Zhiyuan secretly photographs the costumes in the costume-trunk room (until 21:00).
The master phones Liu Wanqing: “Quarter past nine, the costume-trunk room. Bring the account book.”
Cheng Xiaolou slips out of the garden through the side gate to get an injection at the clinic.
Liu Wanqing plays the flute in the waterside pavilion, then switches to the speaker playing the thirty-minute recording and heads along the winding gallery to the costume-trunk room.
The master confronts her over the accounts; at 21:30 Liu Wanqing strangles him with the water sleeve, and the flute membrane tears in the struggle.
From the management office window, Fang Zhiyuan sees a figure on the winding gallery heading toward the costume-trunk room while the flute is still audible.
Liu Wanqing returns to the waterside pavilion along the winding gallery.
Shen Yuetang goes to the costume-trunk room to plead, finds the body and her own water sleeve, flees in panic and drops her hairpin.
The recording ends and the flute music stops.
Cheng Xiaolou returns to the garden through the side gate.
Fang Zhiyuan switches the corridor camera back on.
Gu Qing goes to the costume-trunk room to return the kingfisher-feather headdress and discovers the body.
secrets: Secretly signed a film and TV management contract; found the body at 21:40 but said nothing.
Has vocal-cord nodules and has been getting through on injections; had a huge row with the master; secretly left the garden after closing to see a doctor.
The killer; embezzled more than 600,000 yuan of intangible-heritage subsidy money over five years.
Switched off the camera, secretly photographed the costumes, and privately brokered the sale of the century-old trunks to an overseas collector.
Secretly pawned the heirloom kingfisher-feather headdress and planned to sneak it back into the trunk tonight.
